name: Common toad
note: The common toad's night walk (doc 13, The year, season by season; spring marker; docs/future/11 finds). A find: no needs, no gift, nothing kept but the night's walk in state.spring.toad. WALK (src/world/creatures/spring.js, hourly, deterministic): on spring days walk.days, at walk.startH o'clock (dusk, so it can still be seen: Matt's young testers find things by their light), with walk.chance a night (walk.rainChance when it rained that day), a toad sets out from one of the stones or logs you set (state.basks) whose nearest still fresh water (at least walk.pondCm deep, within walk.reachM) is at least walk.minWalkM away; it prefers one whose damp underneath (src/world/ecology/shelter.js, 0..1) is walk.dampFrom or more, when there is one (L3a). It crawls straight to the water's edge at walk.mPerH meters a game hour (at most walk.mostH hours), sits there walk.sitH hours, then slips in and is gone. LOOK (src/world/creatures/spring-live.js): a blended-SDF toad in real meters (about 10 cm), drawn at displayScale 2.5 (Matt 2026-10-21 rescale): squat, broad, warty (blotch), with copper eyes; a slow crawl, a step every crawl.stepS seconds with a low sway, in real time along the walk's line. find: tap within tapM (plus tapPerM per meter away).
